verdict.rationale: RUN's own docs say pay is automatically deposited into each employee's account on payday, and new hires enter their direct deposit details during electronic onboarding, so direct deposit replaces checks. Nothing in the evidence states the deposit speed (next-day or 2-day) or the payroll submission lead time, which is the 'fast' part of the story. missing for 10: documented next-day/2-day direct deposit timing, payroll submission cutoff/lead-time details, independent or hands-on corroboration of deposit speed.
